components.window_design: Chest inherits accepted128x100 maximum; near/far square envelopes allow canonical component bbox rotation bound, not per-frame fill. Final density still requires actual extraction/sourcefit review.

adapter_changes.before: Create a single horizontal sprite strip for the game character
adapter_changes.after: Create a single horizontal ISOLATED ARMOR COMPONENT strip for the game character

adapter_changes.before: Do not simply copy the still reference pose. Generate distinct animation poses that create a readable cycle or action.
adapter_changes.after: Generate only five requested armor component perspectives matching actual Death220 poses.

adapter_changes.before: Animation action:
adapter_changes.after: Armor component action:

adapter_changes.before: This row owns motion only. Spend the variation budget on limb contacts, arm counter-swing, body height, torso lean, head bob, hair bounce, and loop continuity.
adapter_changes.after: This row owns ONLY five projected armor forms; do not generate the body or motions.

adapter_changes.before: Exactly 5 full-body frames, left to right, in one horizontal row.
adapter_changes.after: Exactly FIVE complete isolated requested armor components, left to right in one horizontal row.

adapter_changes.before: each requested slot must contain exactly one complete full-body pose.
adapter_changes.after: each requested slot contains exactly one complete requested armor component.

adapter_changes.before: - Prefer pose, expression, and silhouette changes over decorative effects.
adapter_changes.after: - Only real requested armor perspective/foreshortening; no decorative effect.

adapter_changes.before: - Effects are allowed only when state-relevant, opaque, hard-edged, sprite-like, fully inside the same frame slot, and physically touching or overlapping the character silhouette.
adapter_changes.after: - No effects or character silhouette in this component-only row.

adapter_changes.before: - Reject any pose that is cropped, overlaps another pose, crosses into a neighboring frame slot, or creates a separate disconnected component that is not attached to the character.
adapter_changes.after: - Reject cropped armor or loose fragments; each isolated component is intentionally independent of a hero drawing.

adapter_changes.before: Preserve the same silhouette, face, proportions, palette, material, and props across every frame.
adapter_changes.after: Preserve accepted component construction/material/density; perspective changes with actual Death220 torso/arm pose. No face/body/other props.
